name: Single-sort expert prefill permutation
description: For inference with batch-one BF16 activations, four selected experts and at least 16 tokens, replace the inverse argsort in MLX-LM's sorted expert path with an integer permutation scatter. Keep the first expert-ID sort, native MXFP4 projection modules, activation and final output gather unchanged. Decode and unsupported interfaces use the supplied reference callable. No weight transform, routing change or cached request data. Hypothesis: remove inverse-sort overhead; native correctness and M4 timing remain required.
